subject: Implement notify_user DBOS step (no agent re-entry)
description:
In `capo/workflows/delegation.py`, implement `notify_user` as a `@DBOS.step` that sends the completion message via `amc_client.send` using `parent_thread_id` from the `delegations` row. **Never** re-enters the agent loop. Idempotency key derived from `(delegation_id, "completion")`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Reads `parent_thread_id`, `summary`, `cost_usd`, `runtime_seconds` from `delegations` row.
- [ ] Calls `amc_client.send(channel_id=parent_thread_id, text=<formatted summary>, idempotency_key=<derived>)`.
- [ ] Step is registered as `@DBOS.step` and uses idempotency framework.
- [ ] Step does NOT call the agent loop; it directly composes the notification message in code (per §5.6 acceptance).

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Restart between completion and notify: idempotency key prevents double-send (matches §10.2 step 6: "AMC mock records exactly one POST").

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] AMC `CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND` on the parent thread: log delegation as orphaned and emit a Logfire span; do not retry.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: complete run sends exactly one notification (verified via call count + idempotency-key header)
• Integration: restart mid-notify produces zero or one final message, never two

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.6, 9.3, 10.2
